title: asperella californica
intro: Asperella californica, commonly known as California earthstar, is a species of fungi in the family Pezizaceae. This plant is a type of edible mushroom that has been used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Asperella californica include its potential to stimulate the immune system, lower cholesterol levels, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
